⚖️ Aviation Leasing, Maintenance Reserves (MR) & Cape Town AI
1. ❌ Lease Technical Bot Bridged to Repossession Plans & MR Release

Asset & Cape Town Disaster: Releases $8M engine Maintenance Reserves or revokes IDERA filing
2. 🔒 Distressed Airline Repossession Dossier & Aircraft ABS Air-Gap
• Lessee-facing technical portals have zero access to default repossession dockets or ABS waterfalls
Anti-Jurisdiction Evasion: 100% blocks lessee utilization bots from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 Engine Maintenance Reserve (MR) Reimbursement & IDERA Lock
• AI audits shop-visit workscopes only; zero direct write to MR drawdowns or IDERA releases
Best Fit: AerCap, SMBC Aviation, Air Lease, Cape Town International Registry & Aircraft ABS
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (Lessor Gate)
• Blocks repossession/ABS reads (record-owner) + blocks MR release overrides (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 688 Scenarios · 1,442 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass
🔥 Lessee FH/FC Report Injection & Aircraft SPV Escrow Scam vs. Zero-Trust

2. [Spoofed Dublin/Utah Aircraft Owner-Trust SPV Escrow Bank Swap] Wires $5,000

✅ Zero-Trust Aviation Leasing & ABS Stack: Repossession Air-Gap + Broker
• Gate 1 (Repossession Dossier & ABS Waterfall Lock): record-owner blocks read in 0.0248ms
• Gate 2 (Maintenance Reserve & Cape Town IDERA Integrity): untrusted-write blocks overrides
• Gate 3 (Immutable SPV Owner Trustee & Engine MRO List): fixed-business-output lock
• Gate 4 (Lessor Egress & MR Reimbursement Wire Gate): restricted-data-boundary & payment block
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | Compliant Engine Escalation Formula Lookup 100.0% Pass
📊 Deterministic Pytest Benchmark (330-FAQ & BRK-670 Milestone!) & Checklist
